verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for a compliance and registered-agent SaaS product like CT Corporation, since such a platform could ship an AI assistant or conversational interface. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing the content was walled off by a Cloudflare challenge, with no evidence of any natural-language command capability, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
